sources.title: IFM/K2-Horizon-0.9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon is an open-weight IFM model family built for transparent foundation-model research, staged checkpoint analysis, and practical deployment. The series spans compact dense models such as K2-Horizon-0.9B for local experimentation, dense mid-size and large models for high-quality research workloads, and mixture-of-expert (MoE) models for higher-capacity serving.
